# GitHub Discussions setup

Enable GitHub Discussions for the repository, then create these categories:

- 📢 Announcements — official project releases and important notices
- 💬 General — community conversation
- 🐛 Bug Reports — problems users encounter (link to Issues when confirmed)
- 💡 Feature Requests — proposed improvements
- 📊 Trading & Journal — workflows, journaling and analytics
- 💱 Forex — Forex-specific discussion
- ₿ Crypto — crypto-specific discussion
- 🛡 Risk Management — position sizing and risk workflows
- 🤖 AI & Analytics — AI-assisted analysis and metrics
- 🎨 UI / UX — interface feedback
- 👨‍💻 Development — architecture and contribution discussion
- 🔌 Integrations — APIs, Google Drive and external services
- 📦 Releases — release discussion and upgrade notes
- 🏆 Show & Tell — community workflows and custom forks

## Community rules

1. Be respectful and constructive.
2. Do not post API keys, passwords, recovery codes, or financial account credentials.
3. Trading discussion is educational and is not financial advice.
4. Security vulnerabilities should be reported privately using SECURITY.md rather than publicly disclosed first.
5. Maintainers may close duplicate, abusive, or off-topic discussions.
